svg.title: HiFi assembly workflow — assembly route map
svg.desc: Full HiFi reads feed independent hifiasm and LJA routes, parallel OATK mitochondrial assembly, and optional MGA. Core assemblies undergo overlap-only purging, optional RagTag or its sorted-purged bypass, then mitochondrial integration. Raw and final QC checkpoints preserve assembler identity. MGA ends at its separate polished first-phase FASTA and native graphs. Required data are blue ellipses.

g.text: Separate from core refinement and QC.
ragtag: N; continue from sorted purged contigs
Blue ellipses: required data. Dashed nodes/routes: optional modules. See the QC map for model, final-mapping and optional-analysis scopes.
